name: Extend the calendar with the US holiday calendar and a new-platform test protocol
what: Add a holiday, regional and platform-expansion layer on top of the existing pillar calendar: map the Q4 holiday season, Black Friday and Cyber Monday, Prime Day, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, back to school and July 4 to content and stock windows, tag slots by language variant, and set a fixed, timeboxed test protocol before the team commits cadence to an emerging platform like Threads or Bluesky. India only (`markets`: ["IN"], reads null for US brands): map Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid and regional harvest festivals the same way instead.
encompasses: Build a rolling US holiday and retail-moment calendar tied to the brand's category, including gifting spikes and periods to avoid tone-deaf posting
Flag holiday-adjacent stock and shipping-cutoff dates so posts never promise delivery the warehouse cannot hit
Tag each calendar slot with the language variant it needs (for example Spanish, or a regional language) so scripts are written once and localized against the same slot
Set a 2-week fixed-cost trial protocol for any new platform with a stated success bar and a kill-or-adopt decision date
Cross-check holiday content pushes against the paid promo calendar so organic and paid do not collide or contradict each other

India only (`markets`: ["IN"], reads null for US brands): build a rolling India festive and cultural calendar (Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, regional harvest festivals) in place of, or alongside, the US holiday calendar
outputs: updated calendar with a holiday and regional layer
trigger: quarterly calendar refresh, or 6 weeks ahead of a major US holiday window (India only, markets IN: ahead of a major festival window instead)
tools: brand brain (to build) for shipping cutoffs and regions
founder_sees: the updated calendar with holiday and regional slots marked, and the platform-test decision date

name: Localize scripts and captions into Spanish and other regional-language variants
what: Once a script or caption is approved in English, produce Spanish and other named regional-language variants for the same post, keeping the same hook structure and claim tier, instead of writing each language from scratch. India only (`markets`: ["IN"], reads null for US brands): produce Hindi, Hinglish and named regional-language variants (Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi) instead.
encompasses: Translate and localize approved hooks, scripts and captions into Spanish, keeping idioms natural rather than literal
Produce named regional-language or dialect variants where the brand's data shows real audience share
Flag words or claims that do not translate cleanly and need a human rewrite rather than a literal pass
Keep on-screen text and burned-in captions synced to the spoken language variant for each cut
Route every localized variant through the same claims and safety gate as the English original before it can publish

India only (`markets`: ["IN"], reads null for US brands): localize into Hindi and Hinglish, plus named regional-language variants (Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi), where the brand's data shows real audience share
inputs: regional audience share from brand data
outputs: localized script and caption set, one per language variant, each tagged to its source post
trigger: on every approved script, before shoot or publish
founder_sees: each localized variant next to the approved English source for a quick native-speaker sanity check

name: Run a unified inbox with triage rules and a defined auto-send FAQ tier
what: Beyond drafting individual replies, build the triage layer: pull comments and DMs from every connected platform into one queue, classify each by intent, auto-send only a defined FAQ tier (shipping, payment method availability, sizing, returns), and route everything else to a human with a suggested draft.
encompasses: Pull comments and DMs from Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn and SMS into one triage queue, plus WhatsApp Business where the brand serves an India, EU or LATAM audience (market option, reads null for a US-only brand)
Classify each message by intent: FAQ, complaint, lead, spam, press or influencer inquiry
Auto-send only messages in a founder-approved FAQ tier (shipping timelines, payment method availability, sizing, return policy) with the exact policy-quoted answer
Escalate complaints, ambiguous questions and anything mentioning a competitor or a claim to a human queue with a suggested draft attached
Check auto-send volume and wording weekly against current platform automation policy so the account is never flagged
Log every auto-sent answer so the same question is never answered two different ways across platforms
inputs: FAQ tier policy from the brand record
outputs: escalated queue with drafts for a human
trigger: continuous, real time

external_write.surface: Instagram/Meta and SMS messaging APIs, write, gated until founder turns it on (WhatsApp Business messaging API added as a market option for India, EU or LATAM audiences)

tools: Meta MCP (read-only until write is enabled)
founder_sees: the FAQ tier definition to approve once, then a weekly sample of auto-sent answers and the full escalated queue

name: Set up and audit shoppable catalog tagging across organic surfaces
what: Beyond confirming a post's link lands on a live matching page, keep the underlying shoppable catalog itself correct: product tags on Instagram and TikTok Shop posts, catalog sync status, and out-of-stock tag removal, so a tapped tag never dead-ends.
encompasses: Audit that every shoppable tag on a live post points to an in-stock, correctly priced catalog entry
Flag catalog sync failures between the store and the connected shopping surface before they cause a broken tag
Remove or swap tags on posts referencing a SKU that has gone out of stock or been discontinued
Check that new product launches get their shoppable tag live before the launch post goes out, not after
Report weekly on tag-to-purchase click-through by post, separate from vanity engagement
outputs: tag audit report with broken or stale tags flagged
trigger: daily automated check, plus before every product launch post

external_write.surface: Meta and TikTok Shop catalog tagging, write, gated

founder_sees: the weekly tag audit and any launch that would have gone out with a dead tag

name: Build a tagged, searchable asset library across the content stack
what: Underneath the reuse-and-retire decision layer, keep the actual library: every raw and edited asset tagged by SKU, hook, format, shoot date and rights status so a reuse decision can be made in seconds instead of by memory.
encompasses: Tag every asset on ingest by SKU, buyer persona, hook, format, shoot date, creator (if seeded) and usage-rights expiry
Flag assets nearing a usage-rights expiry so they get pulled before an unlicensed use happens
Make the library searchable by any tag combination so a specialist can pull 'all Reels for SKU X with hook Y' in one query
Auto-suggest reuse candidates when a new content slot opens that matches an existing tagged asset's SKU and stage
Retire and archive assets past their shelf life on the schedule the reuse policy sets, keeping the working library lean
outputs: reuse suggestion list per open content slot
trigger: on every asset upload, and weekly for the expiry and reuse sweep
founder_sees: the expiring-rights alerts and, on request, any tag search result

name: Automate creator gifting fulfillment, rights and fraud vetting
what: Beyond sourcing and briefing seeded creators, run the operational layer a gifting platform automates: inventory-aware shipment generation, engagement-fraud vetting before gifting, content usage-rights capture, and affiliate or commission tracking for creators who convert sales.
encompasses: Check a creator's follower and engagement pattern for fraud signals before approving a gift, using public profile data only
Generate a gifting shipment automatically from the store's stock feed once a creator is approved, and hold the gift if the SKU is out of stock
Capture usage-rights terms with every seeded creator up front: what the brand can repost, for how long, and whether paid whitelisting is included
Flag content that a creator posted without the agreed usage-rights terms before the brand reuses it anywhere
Track affiliate links or discount codes given to seeded creators against actual orders, separate from paid influencer spend
Log every seeded creator's fulfillment and content status in one place so nothing is gifted twice or forgotten
trigger: on every new creator application or founder-sourced lead
founder_sees: the shortlist to approve before any gift ships, and the monthly affiliate conversion report

name: Attribute organic content to revenue, not platform vanity metrics
what: Beyond reading engagement and reach, tie organic posts to actual orders using UTM tags, promo codes and view-through windows, and report content performance in the same revenue and CAC/LTV terms as paid.
encompasses: Tag every organic post's link and bio destination with a UTM set unique to that post or content series
Issue post-specific promo or referral codes for high-effort content (founder video, creator collab) to measure direct conversion
Compute a view-through attribution window for content that drives brand search rather than direct clicks
Report each content pillar's contribution to new-customer CAC and to repeat-purchase LTV, not just reach and likes
Separate paid-boosted organic posts from pure organic in the attribution report so results are not double-counted
trigger: monthly reporting cadence
founder_sees: the monthly report with revenue and CAC/LTV lines added next to the existing engagement read

name: Score drafts against a live competitive content target before publish
what: Beyond writing the page brief, grade the actual draft against what currently ranks for the target keyword (topic coverage, related terms, structure, length) and iterate before publish, the way a content-score tool would.
encompasses: Pull the current top-ranking pages for the target keyword and extract the terms, questions and structure they share
Score the draft against that target and flag missing sub-topics, thin sections or under-covered related terms
Run a competitor content-gap pass: what the top pages answer that this draft does not
Re-score after each revision so the writer sees the score move, not just a one-time checklist
Cap the score chase against the reading-level and no-padding rules so the draft is not stuffed to hit a number
trigger: on every content brief moving to draft, and again before publish
founder_sees: the score and gap list attached to the draft in review

name: Write and maintain AI-crawler-specific access rules
what: Beyond the general crawlability audit, maintain a named llms.txt file and explicit robots directives for each AI crawler (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot), since these are a distinct, fast-moving list from search-engine crawlers and get missed by a generic technical audit.
encompasses: Maintain a current list of named AI crawlers and what each one is used for (training vs. live answer retrieval)
Set and review allow/disallow rules per crawler in robots.txt, distinct from search-engine bot rules
Publish and keep current an llms.txt file pointing AI systems to the brand's canonical facts and key pages
Re-check the crawler list quarterly, since new AI crawlers appear faster than search engine crawlers do
Flag any AI crawler being blocked by mistake through a hosting or CDN default rule the team did not set on purpose
trigger: quarterly, or when a new major AI crawler is announced

external_write.surface: site robots.txt and llms.txt files, via pull request

founder_sees: the proposed robots.txt and llms.txt diff as a pull request

name: Run original-research PR campaigns and rapid-turnaround newsjacking
what: Beyond general outreach, run the two campaign types digital PR agencies sell separately: a data-journalism campaign built on a proprietary survey or data study, and reactive newsjacking that produces and pitches a comment or mini-study within 24 to 48 hours of a breaking story, plus standing monitoring of journalist query platforms.
encompasses: Design a proprietary survey or data study tied to the brand's category, size the sample, and turn results into shareable graphics and a hosted page
Monitor breaking news and journalist query platforms daily for a category angle the brand can comment on within hours
Draft and get founder sign-off on reactive commentary within a 24 to 48 hour production window
Build and maintain a personalized media list by beat, not a generic press list, and track response rates
Manage embargo terms when a journalist asks for one before running a story
Track earned links and mentions per campaign against the same reporting fields as the always-on link program
outputs: data-journalism campaign package (study, graphics, landing page, pitch list)
reactive commentary drafts with a 24-48hr SLA
trigger: data campaign: quarterly; reactive: on every relevant breaking story, monitored daily

external_write.surface: journalist outreach emails and social amplification, gated

founder_sees: the campaign brief before it launches, and every reactive commentary draft before it is pitched

name: Run named-directory citation audits and Google Business Profile Q&A seeding
what: Beyond the general local SEO and reputation program, run the two specific mechanics a local SEO tool automates: an audit of NAP consistency across a named list of citation directories, and proactive seeding plus monitoring of the Google Business Profile Q&A section.

Flag and correct duplicate or outdated listings found during the citation sweep
Seed the Google Business Profile Q&A section with the brand's own accurate answers before a stranger posts a wrong one
Monitor new Q&A submissions daily and answer within a set response window
Schedule Google Business Profile posts (offers, new arrivals, holiday hours) on the same cadence as the content calendar
outputs: citation consistency audit with fixes needed
GBP Q&A seed answers and monitoring log
trigger: citation audit quarterly; Q&A monitoring daily

external_write.surface: Google Business Profile and citation directory listings, write, gated

name: Close the loop on AI-fact corrections with a re-check cadence and outreach drafts
what: After a wrong AI-stated fact is fixed at the source, keep checking whether each engine actually picked up the fix, how long it took, and auto-draft the outreach note to any third-party publisher whose page is the likely source of the wrong fact.
encompasses: Schedule a re-check of the same prompt set across engines on a fixed cadence after a source fix ships
Record how many days each engine took to reflect the correction, building a per-engine lag record over time
Identify the third-party page an engine is likely citing for a wrong fact and draft a correction request to that publisher
Flag a fact as still wrong after two re-check cycles so it escalates instead of sitting quietly unresolved
Keep a running fact-correction log tied to the brand facts page so repeated errors are visible over time
inputs: third-party publisher pages found during the original audit
outputs: escalation flag for stale wrong facts
trigger: on every source fact fix, then on the standing re-check cadence

external_write.surface: outreach email to third-party publishers, gated

founder_sees: the correction-lag record and every outreach draft before it is sent

name: Run YouTube channel operations and video SEO
what: Own the YouTube channel as a distinct surface with its own mechanics: video titles, descriptions and tags, custom thumbnails, playlists, chapters, end screens, Shorts strategy and the community tab, none of which the general content pillar calendar covers.
encompasses: Write keyword-aware titles, descriptions and tags for every upload, matched to real buyer search terms
Design and test custom thumbnails, since thumbnail choice measurably changes click-through
Group videos into playlists by buyer stage or product line, and add chapters to long-form videos
Set end screens and cards to route viewers to the next video, a playlist, or the shop
Run a Shorts cadence separate from long-form uploads, since Shorts and long-form serve different discovery paths
Post to the Community tab between uploads to keep the channel active in the algorithm
Add closed captions and accurate transcripts to every video, for accessibility and for AI/search crawlability
Track subscriber growth, watch time and click-through by video against the channel's stated goal, not vanity view counts
outputs: published video with optimized metadata and thumbnail
trigger: on every video upload, plus a standing Shorts cadence and monthly reporting
tools: YouTube Data API (to build, read first)
founder_sees: the metadata and thumbnail before an upload goes live, and the monthly channel report

name: Set up and moderate an owned brand community space

Write and publish community guidelines so the space stays on-topic and safe before it grows
Set a standing content and prompt rhythm distinct from the public account's calendar, tuned to superfans not strangers
Plan and run online events (AMAs, early-access drops, polls) and, where relevant, in-person meetups
Moderate daily: remove spam, de-escalate conflict, and route product complaints to support
Mine the space for product feedback and testimonials, feeding both content and product teams
Report member growth, activity and any measurable link to repeat purchase separate from public-account metrics

Write SEO-aware show notes and episode titles with timestamps for every episode
Distribute episodes to Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube with consistent metadata across all three
Clip each long-form episode into short vertical clips for the organic social calendar

Run subscriber growth tactics: referral incentives, cross-recommendations with adjacent newsletters, landing-page opt-ins

name: Run an automated long-form to short-form video repurposing pipeline
what: Take any long-form video (podcast episode, founder talk, livestream) and automatically produce a set of ranked, captioned, correctly-sized short clips for Reels, Shorts and TikTok-equivalent surfaces, instead of an editor manually finding and cutting moments.
encompasses: Transcribe the long-form source and identify candidate moments likely to work as a standalone short clip
Rank candidate clips by an internal engagement-likelihood score, and produce the top-scoring set
Auto-generate styled, synced captions and a resized 9:16 crop for each clip
Insert a text hook at the start of each clip drawn from the clip's own opening line
Apply the brand's fonts, colors and logo placement consistently across every clip
Route the finished clip set into the content calendar with a suggested platform and slot for each one

name: Run social and PR crisis and reputation incident response
what: Detect a reputation-threatening event (a viral complaint, a quality issue going public, a PR incident) early, draft the response statement and channel plan, and route it to the founder before anything is posted, distinct from the routine claims and safety gate on planned content.
encompasses: Set threshold rules for what counts as a reputation-threatening spike (comment volume, sentiment shift, a specific keyword or press mention)
Draft a first-response holding statement within a fixed turnaround window once a threshold fires
Draft the fuller response (apology, fix, policy change) once the founder confirms the facts
Coordinate the same message across every channel it needs to reach (social comments, DMs, a pinned post, press if needed)
Track how the incident spreads and whether the response is closing it down or the story is still growing
Log the incident and the response in the decisions log so the same situation is handled consistently next time
inputs: social listening alert or press mention
outputs: full response draft and channel plan
trigger: on a threshold-triggered spike in negative sentiment, complaint volume or press mention

Track named competitors' mentions and any recurring complaint or praise pattern about them
Identify category-level conversation trends (a rising complaint, a new buyer question, a meme format) worth a content response
Distinguish a genuine trend from noise using a minimum volume and duration threshold before flagging it
Feed a weekly digest of trends and mentions into the content idea bank and the crisis-detection thresholds

Draft carousel-format posts turning a brand data point or case study into a shareable visual sequence
Draft employer-brand and hiring posts (open roles, team culture, workplace milestones) for company page and employee sharing
Coordinate a small employee-advocacy list to reshare key company posts, where employees opt in

what: An agent that continuously scans public posts across Instagram, YouTube and Pinterest for creators already discussing the category or named competitors without mentioning the brand, scores each one against the brand's audience and voice fit, and drafts a personalized outreach and gifting offer for founder batch approval, rather than a person building creator shortlists by hand.
encompasses: Continuously scan public posts for category and competitor mentions from creators not yet connected to the brand
Score each creator on audience fit, engagement authenticity and voice match using only public profile data
Draft a personalized outreach message referencing the creator's actual recent post, not a generic template
Attach a suggested gifting offer sized to the creator's reach tier
Queue scored candidates in weekly batches for one founder approval pass, rather than one-by-one interruptions
Feed accepted creators directly into the gifting fulfillment pipeline (ORG-C14 extension)
